messages:
nina-sales: Quick alert  Enterprise POC (FinSys) is seeing 429 spikes during a scripted load. They mentioned inconsistent Retry-After headers and want an explanation for the CFO. Can we triage?

alvaro-eng: Can we get a sample response + which model and whether embeddings run synchronously?

beth-se: Customer logs: 
```
[2026-03-22T09:45:01Z] 429 POST /v1/chat req=fs_210 client=finsys-poc
Headers: Retry-After: 0, X-RateLimit-Type: per-route, X-Route-Name: chat
Body: {"error":"rate limit exceeded","quota_remaining":0}
[2026-03-22T09:45:05Z] 429 POST /v1/embeddings req=fs_211 client=finsys-poc
Headers: Retry-After: 2, X-RateLimit-Type: burst, X-Route-Name: embeddings
Body: {"error":"rate limit exceeded","quota_remaining":0}
```

kevin-support: Console shows they are on an enterprise trial with daily token_budget=250k but with per-route caps: chat=40rpm, embeddings=20rpm. They ran a stress script that opened 60 concurrent chat streams for 10 minutes to simulate load.

nina-sales: The CFO will want to know: why Retry-After=0 sometimes and why we send different X-RateLimit-Type on different routes. Need a clear explanation.

alvaro-eng: Short answer: Retry-After=0 means the system returned an immediate throttle (no soft backoff window) often for per-route quick rate limiters. Different components apply different limiter strategies (burst vs per-route vs global). We should provide a one-paragraph explanation plus recommended demo limits.

beth-se: Action items: (1) offer a temporary trial uplift for the demo duration (2 days) to avoid CFO optics during procurement, (2) schedule SE session to optimize their demo to one chat socket per simulated user and stagger embedding jobs.

infra-bot: ACTION: temporary-boost by kevin-support applied to account finsys-poc. change_id=chg_20260322_009 TTL=48h. chat_rpm=300, embeddings_rpm=150, token_budget_daily=1000000.

kevin-support: Also note: we've flagged inconsistent Retry-After headers in INF-820; root cause may be a race between limiter decision and header population. Marking high priority.

nina-sales: Thanks everyone. I'll communicate the temporary uplift and the explanation to the CFO. Please send me a short blurb I can paste in the email.

alvaro-eng: Pasting blurb: "Our service uses multiple layers of rate limiting to protect shared capacity: per-route caps prevent a single API surface from overloading the system, burst windows smooth short spikes, and a global request window protects overall tenancy. Different limiters expose different Retry-After behaviors: some return a non-zero soft retry interval, others return 0 to indicate an immediate backoff is required. We recommend limiting concurrent chat sockets to <=4 per demo VM and staggering bulk embeddings jobs to avoid queueing. For predictable demo performance, we can provide a time-bound quota uplift or a Dedicated pilot."

nina-sales: Perfect, sending now. Closing thread once CFO confirms.
